name: Wind Waker
description: The Wind Waker (GameCube) for PlayStation 5: a homebrew port of SwitchWaker on RADV (Aurora, Dawn WebGPU, SDL3), 4K at 60 fps. Bring your own disc image.
author: Gary Riches
release_notes:
First release of The Wind Waker (GameCube) for PlayStation 5 homebrew, built on SwitchWaker. No game data is included: you supply your own disc image.

What it does
- Runs the GameCube game (USA disc, GZLE01 revision 0) natively at 3840x2160.
- 60 images a second by frame interpolation; the game's logic stays at 30.
- 16:9 widescreen, with the HUD at the edges.
- DualSense symbols on the HUD in place of the GameCube's letters, with the buttons mapped by position: Cross is A, Square is B (the sword), Circle is X, Triangle is Y.
- Options menu on the touch pad's click: output and internal resolution, aspect ratio, camera inversion, frame counter and more.
- Shader caches are included, so the first start does not spend minutes compiling.
- Optional HD textures from a Dolphin texture pack you supply: copy it in and it is used from the next start.

Install
- Unpack the zip and copy the folder PPSA99309 to the console as /data/homebrew/PPSA99309/.
- Copy your own disc image (.iso, .gcm or .ciso) into that same folder, beside eboot.bin.
- Start "Wind Waker" from the home screen. The first start asks to create a save file.
- Full steps, controls and the HD texture pack: see the README.

Known limits
- Played on a console only through the opening and Outset Island; later areas are untested there.
- Button pictures inside dialogue text still show the GameCube's buttons.
- With an HD texture pack on, the pack's own button pictures replace the DualSense symbols; Hypatia's pack has an optional PlayStation button set that matches this mapping (see the README).
- Only the USA disc is supported.

Unofficial; not affiliated with SwitchWaker, Nintendo or Sony Interactive Entertainment. Licence: GPL-3.0, sources in SOURCE.txt inside the zip.
